desc:
✈️ Your plane crashed with 500 passengers… now build them an EMPIRE in the jungle!

🏗️ Step on glowing pads to build your fortress, piece by piece
💰 Earn cash every second: chests, droppers and workers
🧍 Find hidden survivors & citizens all over the island. Give them homes and jobs for huge cash boosts!
🌌 Rare MYTHIC & SECRET citizens change every rebirth. Can you find Galaxy Gus?
🐆 Tame pets, fight jaguars & rare beasts, sail boats, go fishing
🛡️ Your safe zone grows as your empire grows
🔁 Rebirth for bigger multipliers

🆕 UPDATE 4: MONKEY PIRATES 🏴‍☠️
• 🐒 Monkey pirates raid your fort, fight them off!
• 👑 Beat the Pirate Captain for treasure & gems
• 🔓 Free rare citizens held captive by pirates
• 🗺️ NEW map: find bosses, animals & places
• 🌈 Rare pets appear every 15 minutes!

🌴 Jungle survival tycoon: build a base, farm, tame pets & grow your island empire!

👍 Like & ⭐ favorite for more updates!
👥 Join the group for +10% cash!
